---
name: Documentation Improvement
about: Suggest a correction, clarification, cross-link, example, or structural improvement.
title: "[DOCS] "
labels: [documentation]
---

## Documentation Area
Identify the affected file, section, diagram, or navigation path.

## Current Content
Summarize what the repository currently says.

## Proposed Improvement
Describe the exact correction, clarification, example, or structural change.

## Reason
Explain why the change improves accuracy, clarity, consistency, accessibility, or usability.

## Supporting Source or Evidence
Provide the source, reference, repository section, standard, or rationale supporting the change.

## Terminology Check
Confirm whether the proposal introduces or changes terms defined in `docs/GLOSSARY.md`.

## Security and Public-Release Check
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, customer data, or confidential infrastructure are included.
- [ ] No unapproved proprietary or patent-sensitive details are included.
- [ ] The proposal avoids unsupported or absolute security claims.

## Acceptance Criteria
List the observable conditions that would make this documentation improvement complete.
